item.title: Two Vehicle Crash Near Birch Tree - Ozark Radio News
item.description: An Accident three miles south of Birch Tree on Highway 99 has injured two Birch Tree Residents. A 42-year-old woman crossed the centerline in a 1997 Honda Odyssey and struck a 2004 Ram 1500 driven by a 42-year-old Birch Tree man. Both drivers sustained minor injuries.
